title: Rav Chanan of Carthage

paragraphs: In [Ketubot 27b](https://www.sefaria.org/Ketubot.27b.16): when Rav Dimi came, he said that Rav Chanan of Carthage related, “A case came before Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi,” etc. [Bava Kamma 114b](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Kamma.114b.23) reads Rav Chana; see also the entry Chinena of Carthage.[^1]

notes.text: The consulted Ketubot gives the case before Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi, with Rabbi as the alternative. Bava Kamma gives Rav Chana and, alternatively, Rav Acha. Compare the name forms in [Seder HaDorot](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1422&lang=en) and [Seder HaDorot](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1502&lang=en).
